title: Asrial vs Cheetah #2 Antarctic Press 1996 Ninja High School Gold Digger
conditionDescription: Spine creasing and wear along the left edge (close-up pictured); back cover lightly soiled.
descriptionText:
Asrial vs. Cheetah #2 of 2 (April 1996), Antarctic Press - Ninja High School / Gold Digger crossover. $2.95 cover price.

Back cover: Antarcticon 1997 ad (San Antonio, TX).

Condition: creasing and wear along the spine (see close-up), light soiling on the back cover.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
